methods_quotes.q: calculated as the mean percentage of patient visits for ILI during noninfluenza weeks for the preceding three influenza seasons
Noninfluenza weeks are those in which <10% of laboratory specimens are positive for influenza.
National and regional percentages of patient visits for ILI are weighted on the basis of state population.
The epidemic threshold is 1.645 standard deviations above the seasonal baseline.
